title: Auditing LLMs for Algorithmic Fairness in Casenote-Augmented Tabular Prediction

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multi-class algorithmic fairness metrics, specifically Statistical Parity (SP) and Equality of Opportunity (EoO), by comparing predictive error disparities and True Positive Rates between male and female client subgroups on a housing placement prediction task.

Evaluating multi-class algorithmic fairness metrics, specifically Statistical Parity (SP) and Equality of Opportunity (EoO), by comparing predictive error disparities and True Positive Rates across different racial subgroups (White/Caucasian, Black/African American, and Other) on a housing placement prediction task.
